item.title: Statistical Analysis Methods in Target Trial Emulation
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor We read the article by Edouard L Fu et al[1] with great interest. item.title: When clinical trials become local industries, who safeguards participant benefit
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, Murphy’s feature on China’s rise as a global leader in clinical trials (1) captures an important inflection point: trial capacity is no longer merely “shifting” but being strategically cultivated through regulation, investment, and a dense hospital infrastructure that makes recruitment faster and cheaper than in many settings. item.title: Primary Care needs a proportional vascular framework for Long Covid
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, Lang’s feature (1) helpfully reframes covid-19 as a condition whose clinical burden is often mediated through the vasculature rather than confined to the airways, and it reminds clinicians that cardiovascular symptoms span both acute infection and long covid.
